verdict.rationale: Unreal's own Python editor-scripting docs describe automating repetitive asset-management tasks, such as generating LODs for Static Meshes, and automating the placement, layout and settings of Actors in Levels. The cook commandlet also accepts multiple platforms and maps in one invocation. Bulk operations are therefore possible, but only by writing scripts or commands, not through an evidenced batch-edit feature. Missing for 10: an explicit documented multi-select/batch-edit capability, evidence of bulk operations through Remote Control for agent-driven use, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Automate time-consuming Asset management tasks in the Unreal Editor, like generating Levels of Detail (LODs) for Static Meshes.
Automate or randomize the placement, layout and settings of Actors in your Levels, Create your own Asset import and management pipelines
